source.citation: [Unresolved Beaubien-group identification] "Fort Dearborn and Chicago in 1831." Labeled wood-engraved panorama after a sketch attributed to Juliette A. Kinzie; the local reproduction credits Wau-Bun, Chicago, 1857.
what_it_does_not_supply: which of the currently modeled Beaubien buildings the keyed group depicts
a surveyed coordinate, a metric dimension or a camera calibration
independent proof of the pictured buildings’ material, storey count, openings or chimney count on 1 July 1835
proof that two reproductions of the Wau-Bun composition are independent witnesses
what_it_supplies: a panorama labeled Chicago in 1831, with a keyed Gen. J. B. Beaubien’s group
the drawn order of the separately keyed Dean, Beaubien, fort and north-bank groups
an existing credited contextual image to investigate before assigning facade details
